title: Quickstart release tools publish no stand origin: WP fix-measure.json and fingerprints, EmDash report origin
steps: S1: In vendor/wordpress/tracy-wordpress-theme/skills/tracy-wordpress-theme run: npm ci, then node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-reporter=tap scripts/test/verification-portable.test.mjs ../../../../../packages/cms/tracy-emdash-theme-base/tests/release-local-paths.test.mjs
S2: Read the result of each test.
expect: A source fingerprint on a loopback stand is published on https://quickstart.invalid with a recomputed id that validates; the published fix-measure.json holds no loopback origin or machine path and is still a valid tracy-fix-measure/v1; a /home/... site route stays whole; shownOrigin writes loopback, private and .test/.local stands as http://localhost and keeps other origins.
evidence: Published JA Diner and JA Restaurant WP releases carried http://127.0.0.1:<port> in fix-measure.json (site, source, sourceFingerprint.url) and VERIFICATION.json (measure.sourceFingerprint.url); five EmDash -0.x releases carried it in VERIFICATION.json report.origin; route /home/home-red was published as home-red.
fence: Release tooling only; no theme, pack or fleet change.

tests: a source fingerprint is published on the placeholder origin
VERIFICATION.json carries the measure and baseline fingerprints
a site route under /home is not a machine path
writes a stand of the builder machine as the local origin
